top_claim: The exact build-cache v1.2 target artifact prevents unauthorized cross-tenant cache access and denied-action side effects for the declared workload and environment.

claims.statement: Trusted runtime identity, not caller input, establishes tenant and principal scope.
assumptions: The embedding gateway supplies an authenticated context only after successful mutual authentication.
limitations: Runtime negative tests and gateway deployment evidence are NOT_RUN.

claims.statement: Denied and cross-tenant operations have no observable storage, cache, quarantine, process, or external-call side effect in the protected scope.
limitations: Development, negative, holdout, and representative workload executions are NOT_RUN.

claims.statement: Only exact, owned, unexpired, non-revoked, independently signed evidence can authorize reuse, routing, or checkpoint adoption.
assumptions: Operational trust stores and revocation sources are configured correctly.
limitations: No production trust-store or revocation exercise is attached.

claims.statement: Repository-controlled input cannot choose an executable parity runner or broaden authorization.
limitations: The parity harness is not connected to a production allowlisted runner service.

residual_risks.description: No independent negative, holdout, representative, mutation, or production-equivalent tenant-isolation execution exists.
Provider adapter, context compaction, parity harness, and SLO autotuner remain disconnected from production-shaped runtime composition.
PostgreSQL migration and service behavior are NOT_RUN.

monitoring_obligations: Monitor cross-tenant denial counts without recording tenant secrets.
Alert on trust, expiry, revocation, ownership, and evidence-integrity failures.
Latch rollback on any false hit, cross-tenant hit, corrupt execution, or under-validated publication.
